import json, os, re, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone

task = Path('/tmp/yunle-native-games.uGZuY9')
log = task / 'blank-warmup-phase.log'
output = task / 'blank-warmup-phase-rss.json'
command = ['xcodebuild', 'test-without-building', '-xctestrun', str(task / 'blank-warmup-phase.xctestrun'), '-destination', 'platform=iOS Simulator,id=4502D5E9-9630-4AF0-9050-3C9109139FD0', '-parallel-testing-enabled', 'NO', '-collect-test-diagnostics', 'never', '-only-testing:YunleFunTests/NativeGameStartupPhaseLiveTests/testHeldBlankPageStartupPhaseForGomoku', '-resultBundlePath', str(task / 'blank-warmup-phase.xcresult')]
started = time.monotonic()
seen_hosts, web_hosts, births, events, samples = set(), {}, {}, [], []
active, offset, pending = None, 0, ''
with log.open('w') as stream:
    process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    try:
        while True:
            with log.open() as reader:
                reader.seek(offset)
                fresh = reader.read()
                offset = reader.tell()
            pending += fresh
            lines = pending.split('\n')
            pending = lines.pop()
            for line in lines:
                host = re.search(r'YunleFun\[(\d+):', line)
                web = re.search(r'WebContent\[(\d+)\]', line)
                if host:
                    seen_hosts.add(int(host[1]))
                if host and web:
                    web_hosts[int(web[1])] = int(host[1])
                marker = re.search(r'YUNLEFUN_BLANK_PROBE_(BEGIN|END).*?iteration[=:]\s*(\d+).*?hostPID[=:]\s*(\d+)', line)
                if marker:
                    stage, iteration, pid = marker[1], int(marker[2]), int(marker[3])
                    seen_hosts.add(pid)
                    events.append({'kind':stage,'iteration':iteration,'hostPID':pid,'monitorElapsedSeconds':time.monotonic()-started})
                    active = iteration if stage == 'BEGIN' else None
            pids = sorted(seen_hosts | set(web_hosts))
            if pids:
                ps = subprocess.run(['ps','-p',','.join(map(str,pids)),'-o','pid=,rss=,lstart=,comm='],capture_output=True,text=True)
                for line in ps.stdout.splitlines():
                    parts=line.split(maxsplit=7)
                    if len(parts)!=8: continue
                    pid,rss=int(parts[0]),int(parts[1]);birth=' '.join(parts[2:7]);name=Path(parts[7]).name
                    role='native-test-host' if pid in seen_hosts and name=='YunleFun' else 'host-log-observed-WebContent' if pid in web_hosts and 'WebContent' in name else None
                    if role is None: continue
                    if pid in births and births[pid]!=birth: continue
                    births[pid]=birth
                    samples.append({'monitorElapsedSeconds':time.monotonic()-started,'observedBlankProbeCase':active,'pid':pid,'role':role,'hostPID':pid if role=='native-test-host' else web_hosts[pid],'processName':name,'processStartTime':birth,'residentSizeKiB':rss})
            if process.poll() is not None: break
            time.sleep(0.5)
    finally:
        result={'kind':'external-ps-rss-blank-page-diagnostic','recordedAt':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'command':command,'xcodebuildPID':process.pid,'exitCode':process.poll(),'intervalSeconds':0.5,'events':events,'samples':samples,'limits':['RSS from macOS ps, not physical footprint, JS heap, unique allocations or a leak detector. Native test host includes XCTest; it is separate from WebContent.','Only PIDs explicitly observed as WebContent in this exact YunleFun test-host log are sampled, checked for executable basename and stable process start time. Prior WebContent can remain alive; no RSS sum is called the active game memory.','Case intervals follow when BEGIN/END log markers are observed by this monitor; log delivery and polling delays remain, not exact cross-clock alignment.','Simulator and observer overhead; no real-device memory/frame claim; no credentials, environment, argv or descriptors collected.']}
        output.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'exitCode':result['exitCode'],'events':len(events),'rssSamples':len(samples),'output':str(output)}))
raise SystemExit(result['exitCode'] if result['exitCode'] is not None else 1)
